extracted.intended_audience: potential authors and reviewers submitting manuscripts to Biochemia Medica (biomedical researchers)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines and editorial policy changes for preparing and submitting manuscripts to Biochemia Medica, including new research-integrity resources, revised Instructions to authors, an updated Author statement form, and mandatory conflict-of-interest disclosure. Covers required statements, forms, and submission procedures intended to improve research and publication integrity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Integrity Corner / research integrity awareness
rubrics_metrics.description: Launch of a special journal section called Research Integrity Corner to publish educational articles dealing with different research and publication misconduct issues.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aimed to raise awareness of potential authors and reviewers for research and publication integrity issues; educational articles will address misconduct topics to improve quality and ethical standards of submissions and published articles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adherence to Instructions to authors (manuscript preparation and submission)
rubrics_metrics.description: Revised Instructions to authors not only give recommendations for manuscript preparation and submission but also describe the editorial procedure for all submitted articles and provide exact journal policies towards research integrity, authorship, copyright and conflict of interest.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors must follow the updated Instructions to authors which now include procedural and policy requirements (beyond formatting), making the journal's ethical policies and requirements visible and available to all potential authors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authorship (statements of authorship)
rubrics_metrics.description: The revised Authorship and copyright form is now called the Author statement form and contains statements on the authorship.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors are required to make explicit statements regarding authorship (presumably responsibility, contribution, and agreement), as part of the Author statement form to be uploaded during online submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Originality of work (novelty / originality statement)
rubrics_metrics.description: Author statement form contains statements on the originality of work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors must assert that the submitted work is original (i.e., not published elsewhere and not under consideration elsewhere) as part of the Author statement form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research ethics (ethics compliance statement)
rubrics_metrics.description: Author statement form contains statements on research ethics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors must declare compliance with applicable research ethics (e.g., ethical approval, humane treatment of subjects) in the Author statement form; this is part of the journal's effort to make ethical requirements explicit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patient privacy and confidentiality
rubrics_metrics.description: Author statement form contains statements on patient privacy and confidentiality.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors must attest to protecting patient privacy and confidentiality where applicable, as a required element of the Author statement form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Copyright transfer
rubrics_metrics.description: Author statement form includes copyright transfer provisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors are required to address copyright transfer in the Author statement form (transfer terms included in the revised form).

rubrics_metrics.name: Conflict-of-interest disclosure (ICMJE Form)
rubrics_metrics.description: Journal has adopted the ICMJE Form for Disclosure of Potential Conflicts of Interest.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each submitted article, authors are requested to fill out the 'ICMJE Form for Disclosure of Potential Conflicts of Interest' as part of the submission process; the journal requires use of this standardized form to disclose potential conflicts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission procedure: required upload of forms
rubrics_metrics.description: From this issue, for each submitted article, authors are requested to fill out the ICMJE form as well as the Author statement form and upload those forms during the online manuscript submission process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: As a procedural requirement, authors must complete and upload both the Author statement form and the ICMJE conflict-of-interest form when submitting manuscripts online; failure to include these forms would not comply with the updated submission requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editorial procedure transparency / explicit journal policies
rubrics_metrics.description: The revised Instructions to authors provide exact journal policies towards research integrity, authorship, copyright and conflict of interest and describe the editorial procedure for all submitted articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The journal expects authors to be aware of and comply with clearly stated editorial procedures and policy positions; making these policies explicit is intended to improve submission and publication quality and integrity.
